stories.title: Sources: Big 12 drops lawsuit against Texas Tech
stories.summary: The Big 12 has withdrawn the federal lawsuit it filed against Texas Tech in June amid questions of former quarterback Brendan Sorsby's eligibility, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel on Monday.

stories.title: Tua to start, but Falcons mum on QB after Week 1
stories.summary: Tua Tagovailoa will be the starting quarterback for the Falcons against the Steelers in Week 1.

stories.title: U-M coach gives Underwood tepid backing as QB1
stories.summary: Michigan will continue to start Bryce Underwood at quarterback despite struggles in the season opener, coach Kyle Whittingham said Monday.

stories.title: Manning eyes 2nd shot at OSU after 'rough' debut
stories.summary: Arch Manning says he doesn't like to think about his ill-fated debut against the Buckeyes last year as his Longhorns look for redemption this Saturday.

stories.title: Cowboys Pro Bowl guard Smith headed for IR
stories.summary: Cowboys starting left guard Tyler Smith will undergo thumb surgery and is headed to injured reserve, coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday.
